text.en:
Increase In Branches of Courts of First Instance. Section 50 of the Judiciary Act of 1948
(Republic Act No. 296, as amended) is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 50. Judges of First Instance of Judicial Districts. Sixteen judges shall be commissioned for the First
Judicial District. Seven judges shall preside over the Court of the First Instance of the Province of Cagayan,
and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh branches thereof; the
judges of the second branch to preside also over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Batanes;
"Five judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Nueva Vizcaya, and shall be
known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof; and
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Quirino.
"Twenty-eight judges shall be commissioned for the Second Judicial District. Six judges shall preside over the
Court of First Instance of the Province of Ilocos Norte and the City of Laoag, and shall be known as judges of
the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth branches thereof;
"Six judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Ilocos Sur, and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth branches thereof;
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Abra, and shall be known as
judges of the first and second branches thereof;
"Four judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Benguet and the City of Baguio,
and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third and fourth branches thereof;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of Mountain Province;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Ifugao;

"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Kalinga-Apayao, and shall be
known as judges of the first and second branches thereof;
"Six judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of La Union, and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth branches thereof;
"Seventeen judges shall be commissioned for the Third Judicial District. Fourteen judges shall preside over
the Court of First Instance of the Province of Pangasinan and the Cities of Dagupan and San Carlos, and shall
be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth, eleventh,
twelfth, thirteenth, and fourteenth branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Zambales and the City of
Olongapo, and shall be known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof.
"Thirteen judges shall be commissioned for the Fourth Judicial District. Nine judges shall preside over the
Court of First Instance of the Province of Nueva Ecija and the Cities of Cabanatuan, Palayan and San Jose,
and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth and ninth branches
thereof; and
"Four judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Tarlac, and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, third and fourth branches thereof.
"Twenty-four judges shall be commissioned for the Fifth Judicial District. Ten judges shall preside over the
Court of First Instance of the Province of Pampanga and the City of Angeles, and shall be known as judges of
the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Bataan, and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, and third branches thereof; and
"Eleven judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Bulacan, and shall be known
as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth and eleventh branches
"Forty-five judges shall be commissioned for the Sixth Judicial District. They shall preside over the Court of
First Instance of the City of Manila, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth,
seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth, eleventh, twelfth, thirteenth, fourteenth, fifteenth, sixteenth, seventeenth,
eighteenth, nineteenth, twentieth, twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third, twenty-fourth, twenty-fifth,
twenty-sixth, twenty-seventh, twenty-eighth, twenty-ninth, thirtieth, thirty-first, thirty-second, thirty-third,
thirty-fourth, thirty-fifth, thirty-sixth, thirty-seventh, thirty-eighth, thirty-ninth, fortieth, forty-first,
forty-second, forty-third, forty-fourth and forty-fifth branches thereof.
"Seventy-two judges shall be commissioned for the Seventh Judicial District, Sixty-two judges shall preside
over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Rizal and the Cities of Quezon, Pasay and Caloocan and
shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth, eleventh,
twelfth, thirteenth, fourteenth, fifteenth, sixteenth, seventeenth, eighteenth, nineteenth, twentieth, twenty-first,
twenty-second, twenty-third, twenty-fourth, twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth, twenty-seventh, twenty-eighth,
twenty-ninth, thirtieth, thirty-first, thirty-second, thirty-third, thirty-fourth, thirty-fifth, thirty-sixth,
thirty-seventh, thirty-eighth, thirty-ninth, fortieth, forty-first, forty-second, forty-third, forty-fourth, forty-fifth,
forty-sixth, forty-seventh, forty-eighth, forty-ninth, fiftieth, fifty-first, fifty-second, fifty-third, fifty-fourth,
fifty-fifth, fifty-sixth, fifty-seventh, fifty-eighth, fifty-ninth, sixtieth, sixty-first, and sixty-second branches
"Six judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Cavite and the Cities of Cavite,
Tagaytay and Trece Martires, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth
branches thereof; and
"Four judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Palawan and the City of Puerto

Princesa, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, and fourth branches thereof.
"Twenty-one judges shall be commissioned for the Eight Judicial District. Nine judges shall preside over the
Court of First Instance of the Province of Laguna and the City of San Pablo, and shall be known as judges of
the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth and ninth branches thereof;
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Mindoro Oriental, and shall be
known as judges of the first and second branches thereof; and
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Mindoro Occidental, and shall be
known as the judges of the first and second branches thereof.
"Eleven judges shall be commissioned for the Ninth Judicial District. Ten judges shall preside over the Court
of First Instance of the Province of Quezon and the City of Lucena, and shall be known as judges of the first,
second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth branches thereof; and
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the sub-Province of Aurora.
"Thirty-two judges shall be commissioned for the Tenth Judicial District. Ten judges shall preside over the
Court of First Instance of the Province of Camarines Sur and Cities of Naga, Iriga and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Camarines Norte, and shall be
known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Nine judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Albay and the Cities of Legaspi,
and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, and ninth branches
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Catanduanes, and shall be known
as judges of the first and second branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Sorsogon, and shall be known
as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof; and
"Five judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Masbate, and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, third, fourth and fifth branches thereof.
"Twenty-three judges shall be commissioned for the Eleventh Judicial District. Five judges shall preside over
the Court of First Instance of the Province of Capiz and the City of Roxas, and shall be known as judges of the
first, second, third, fourth and fifth branches thereof;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Romblon;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Marinduque;
"Four judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Aklan, and shall be known as the
first, second, third and fourth branches thereof;
"Ten judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Iloilo and the City of Iloilo, and
shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, and tenth
branches thereof; and
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Antique, and shall be known as
judges of the first and second branches thereof.
"Twenty-one judges shall be commissioned for the Twelfth Judicial District. Twelve judges shall preside over
the Court of First Instance of the Province of Occidental Negros and the Cities of Bacolod, Silay, San Carlos,
La Carlota, Bago and Cadiz, and shall be as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh,
eighth, ninth, tenth, eleventh and twelfth branches thereof;
"Eight judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Oriental Negros and the Cities

of Dumaguete, Canlaon and Bais, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth,
seventh and eighth branches thereof; and
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Siquijor.
"Twenty-one judges shall be commissioned for the Thirteenth Judicial District. Four judges shall preside over
the Court of First Instance of the Province of Northern Samar, and shall be known as judges of the first,
second, third and fourth branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Samar and City of Calbayog,
and shall be known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Eastern Samar, and shall be
known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Nine judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Leyte and the Cities of Tacloban
and Ormoc, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth and
ninth branches thereof; and
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Southern Leyte, and shall be
known as judges of the first and second branches thereof.
"Twenty judges shall be commissioned for the Fourteenth Judicial District. Sixteenth judges shall preside over
the Court of First Instance of the Province of Cebu and the Cities of Cebu, Mandaue, Danao, Toledo and
Lapu-Lapu, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth,
tenth, eleventh, twelfth, thirteenth, fourteenth, fifteenth and sixteenth branches thereof; and
"Four judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Bohol and the City of
Tagbilaran, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, third and fourth branches thereof.
"Twenty-three judges shall be commissioned for the Fifteenth Judicial District. Three judges shall preside
over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Surigao del Norte and the City of Surigao, and shall be
known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Surigao del Sur, and shall be
known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Agusan del Norte and the City of
Butuan, and shall be known as judges of the first and second branches thereof;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Agusan del Sur;
"Five judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Misamis Oriental and the Cities
of Cagayan de Oro and Gingoog, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth and fifth
branches thereof;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Camiguin;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Bukidnon, and shall be known
as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Lanao del Norte and the City of
Iligan, and shall be known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof; and
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Lanao del Sur and the City of
Marawi, and shall be known as judges of the first and second branches thereof.
"Thirty-six judges shall be commissioned for the Sixteenth Judicial District. Six judges shall preside over the
Court of First Instance of the Province of Davao del Sur and the City of Davao, and shall be known as judges
of the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Davao del Norte, and shall be

known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Davao Oriental, and shall be
known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Maguindanao and the City of
Cotabato, and shall be known as judges of the first, second and third branches thereof;
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of North Cotabato, and shall be
known as judges of the first and second branches thereof;
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Sultan Kudarat;
"Two judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of South Cotabato and the City of
General Santos, and shall be known as judges of the first and second branches thereof;
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Misamis Occidental and the
Cities of Oroquieta, Ozamiz and Tangub, and shall be known as judges of the first, second and third branches
"Five judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur ands the
Cities of Zamboanga and Pagadian, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third, fourth and fifth
branches thereof;
"Four judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Zamboanga del Norte and the
Cities of Dipolog and Dapitan, and shall be known as judges of the first, second, third and fourth branches
"One judge shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Basilan; and
"Three judges shall preside over the Court of First Instance of the Province of Sulu, and shall be known as
judges of the first, second, and third branches thereof, the judge of the third branch to preside also over the
Court of First Instance of Tawi-Tawi."

Re-Structuring of Courts of First Instance. Section 52 of the Judiciary Act of 1948 (Republic Act
No. 296, as amended) is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 52. Permanent Stations of District Judges. The permanent station of the judges of the Sixth Judicial
District shall be in the City of Manila.
"In other judicial districts, the permanent stations of the judges shall be as follows:
"For the First Judicial District. Three judges (Branches I, V and VI) of the Court of First Instance of the
Province of Cagayan shall be stationed in the Municipality of Tuguegarao, Province of Cagayan; two judges
(Branches II and VII) of the same court, in the Municipality of Aparri, same province; one judge (Branch III)
of the same court, in the Municipality of Tuao, same province; and one judge (Branch IV) of the same court,
in the Municipality of Sanchez Mira, same province;
"One judge (Branch I) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Isabela shall be stationed in the
Municipality of Ilagan, Province of Isabela; one judge (Branch II) of the same court, in the Municipality of
Cauayan, same province, one judge (Branch III) of the same court, in the Municipality of Cabagan, same
province; one judge (Branch IV) of the same court, in the Municipality of Roxas, same province; and one
judge (Branch V) of the same court, in the Municipality of Echague, same province;
"Three judges (Branches I, II and III) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Nueva Vizcaya shall be
stationed in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya; and
"The judge of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Quirino shall be stationed in the Municipality of
Cabarroguis, Province of Quirino.
"For the Second Judicial District, four judges (Branches I, II, III and IV) of the Court of First Instance of the

Province of Ilocos Norte and the City of Laoag shall be stationed in the City of Laoag; one judge (Branch IV)
of the same Court, in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte; and one judge (Branch V) of the
same court, in the Municipality of Bangui, same Province.
"Two judges (Branches I and III) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Ilocos Sur shall be stationed
in the Municipality of Vigan, Province of Ilocos Sur; one judge (Branch II) of the same court, in the
Municipality of Narvacan, same province; one judge (Branch IV) of the same court, in the Municipality of
Candon, same province; one judge (Branch V) of the same court, in the Municipality of Cabugao, same
province; and one judge (Branch VI) of the same court, in the Municipality of Tagudin, same province.
"Three judges (Branch I, II and IV) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Benguet and the City of
Baguio shall be stationed in the City of Baguio; and one judge (Branch III) of the same court, in the
Municipality of La Trinidad, Province of Benguet;
"The judge of the Court of First Instance of Mountain Province shall be stationed in the Municipality of
Bontoc, Mountain Province;
"The judge of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Ifugao shall be stationed in the Municipality of
Lagawe, Province of Ifugao;
"One judge (Branch I) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Kalinga-Apayao shall be stationed in
the Municipality of Tabuk, Province of Kalinga-Apayao; and one judge (Branch II) of the same court, in the
Municipality of Luna, same province;
"The two judges (Branches I and II) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Abra shall be stationed in
the Municipality of Bangued, Province of Abra; and
"Two judges (Branches I and II) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of La Union shall be stationed
in the Municipality of San Fernando, La Union. Two judges (Branches III and VI) of the same court, in the
Municipality of Agoo, same province; one judge (Branch IV) of the same court, in the Municipality of
Bauang, same province; and one judge (Branch V) of the same court, in the Municipality of Balaoan, same
"For the Third Judicial District, three judges (Branches I, II and XI) of the Court of First Instance of the
Province of Pangasinan and the Cities of Dagupan and San Carlos shall be stationed in the Municipality of
Lingayen, Province of Pangasinan; four judges (Branches II, IV, VIII and XII) of the same court, in the City
of Dagupan; two judges (Branches V and IX of the same court, in the Municipality of Urdaneta, Province of
Pangasinan; one judge (Branch VI) of the same court, in the Municipality of Tayug, same province; one judge
(Branch XIV) of the same court, in the Municipality of Rosales, same province; Two judges (Branches VII
and XIII) of the same court, in the Municipality of Alaminos, same province; and one judge (Branch X) of the
same court, in the City of San Carlos;
"Two judges (Branches I and III) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Zambales and the City of
Olongapo shall be stationed in the City of Olongapo; and one judge (Branch II) of the same court, in the
Municipality of Iba, Province of Zambales.
"For the Fourth Judicial District, four judges, (Branches I, II, III and VII) of the Court of First Instance of the
Province of Nueva Ecija and the Cities of Cabanatuan, Palayan and San Jose, shall be stationed in the City of
Cabanatuan; one judge (Branch IV) of the same court, in the Municipality of Guimba, Province of Nueva
Ecija; two judges (Branches V and IX) of the same court, in the Municipality of Gapan, same province; one
judge (Branch VI) of the same court, in the Municipality of Santo Domingo, same province; and one judge

"The four judges (Branches I, II, III and IV) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Tarlac shall be
stationed in the Municipality of Tarlac, Province of Tarlac.
"For the Fifth Judicial District, four judges (Branches I, III, V and VI) of the Court of First Instance of the

Province of Pampanga and the City of Angeles shall be stationed in the Municipality of San Fernando,

same province; One judge (Branch VII) of the same court, in the Municipality of Macabebe, same province;
and three judges (Branches IV, IX and X) of the same court, in the City of Angeles.
"Three judges (Branches I, II and III) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Bataan shall be
stationed in the Municipality of Balanga, Province of Bataan;
"Five judges (Branches I, II, VI, VII and IX) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Bulacan shall be

Municipality of Santa Maria, same province.
"For the Seventh Judicial District, fifteen judges (Branches I, II, VI, VIII, X, XI, XIII, XIX, XX, XXI, XXII,
XIII, XXIV, XXV and XXVI) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Rizal and the Cities of Quezon,

"One judge (Branch I) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Cavite and the Cities of Cavite,

"The four judges (Branches I, II, III and IV) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Palawan and the

"For the Eighth Judicial District, two judges (Branches I and VII) of the Court of First Instance of the
Province of Laguna and the City of San Pablo shall be stationed in the Municipality of Biñan, Province of
Laguna; two judges (Branches II and IV) of the same court, in the Municipality of Santa Cruz, same province;
two judges (Branches III and VIII) of the same court, in the City of San Pablo; one judge (Branch V) of the
same court, in the Municipality of Siniloan, same province; and two judges (Branches VI and IX) of the same

"Two judges (Branches I and II) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Batangas and the Cities of
Lipa and Batangas shall be stationed in the City of Batangas; one judge (Branch III) of the same court, in the
Municipality of Lemery, Province of Batangas; two judges (Branches IV and V) of the same court, in the

"One judge (Branch I) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Mindoro Oriental shall be stationed in

"One judge (Branch I) of the Court of First Instance of the Province of Mindoro Occidental shall be stationed
in the Municipality of Mamburao, Province of Mindoro Occidental; and one judge (Branch II) of the same

"For the Ninth Judicial District, six judges (Branches I, II, VI, VII, VIII and IX) of the Court of First Instance

Special Provisions on Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts.
(a) In provinces and cities where there are no Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts, the Supreme Court,
when so warranted, shall designate and authorize any branch of the Court of First Instance therein to function
as Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court.
(b) The Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts stationed in the Cities of Manila, Quezon, Caloocan and
Pasay shall have jurisdiction over all cases within the entire Metro Manila area and the Supreme Court shall
define their respective territorial jurisdiction.
(c) The existing Criminal, Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court of Dumaguete City is converted into a
regular Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court with jurisdiction over all cases in the province of Negros
Oriental and the Cities of Dumaguete, Bais and Canlaon and the incumbent presiding judge of the former
court as now converted shall continue as judge without the need of a new appointment. The pending criminal
cases of the former court which do not pertain to the jurisdiction of Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts
shall be transferred to the Regular City Courts.

Court Personnel Equipment And Facilities. The additional courts herein created shall each be
provided with the necessary personnel, equipment and facilities to enable them to function as soon as the
judges therein are appointed.

Transitory Provisions.
(a) Upon appointment of a judge or judges to a newly created branch or branches of a Court of First Instance
or City Courts, all pending cases in the branches pertaining to one administrative area in which the trial has
not commenced shall be equitably distributed among all said branches in accordance with such rules and
regulations as the Supreme Court shall prescribe: PROVIDED, HOWEVER, That all cases pending before
any existing branch, the trial of which has commenced, shall remain therein until final disposition.
(b) Upon the organization of the Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts herein created, the Supreme Court
shall cause all cases and proceedings pending before any court which are properly cognizable by the Juvenile
and Domestic Relations Courts to be transferred thereto.

Appropriations. The sums of P19,000,000.00 for Courts of First Instance, P2,000,000.00 for City
Courts and P3,000,000.00 for Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts or so much thereof as may be necessary
to carry out the purposes of this Decree are hereby authorized to be appropriated. The appropriation for the
succeeding years shall be included in the Annual General Appropriations Decree.

Repealing Clause. All laws, decrees and orders of any part thereof which are inconsistent with
the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
